chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Share with him who has an abundant livelihood, for he is more probable to get more riches and likely to secure an increase of the share therein.
ai.seo_question: Why should one share wealth with the prosperous according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) advises partnering with those experiencing an influx of sustenance (rizq), as their current prosperity makes them more apt to retain and multiply wealth. This principle reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of 'circulating wealth' (tadawul al-mal), where engaging with the prosperous ensures stability and mutual benefit, contrasting with the risk of partnering with the unstable or destitute.
